assumptions.statement: Submitted boundary and key areas use provisional rough geometry.
assumptions.impact: All area-sensitive metrics and figures must be recalculated after official polygons are available.

assumptions.statement: Planning controls, road redlines, ownership, utilities, and engineering constraints require official confirmation.
assumptions.impact: Intensity, height, setbacks, and implementation timing remain conceptual.

assumptions.statement: Each AI scenario must pass G1 public purpose and non-AI baseline before pilot use.
assumptions.impact: Scenarios without baseline remain discussion material.

assumptions.statement: Each AI scenario must pass G2 minimum data and human review.
assumptions.impact: Automated decisions are not treated as standalone city decisions.

assumptions.statement: Each AI scenario must pass G3 small pilot and stop condition.
assumptions.impact: Scaling is blocked when stop criteria or recovery paths are missing.

assumptions.statement: Each AI scenario must pass G4 public review and recovery record.
assumptions.impact: Every pilot needs a readable review trail before expansion.

assumptions.statement: Event operation roles and responsibilities require later assignment.
assumptions.impact: Annual and quarterly programs are reference concepts.

assumptions.statement: Operational indicators need baselines collected through authorized public processes.
assumptions.impact: Satisfaction, response time, and participation indicators remain unknown until pilots begin.
